snippet.title: Little Planet - Official Launch Trailer | Meta Quest
snippet.description:
Little Planet: Your ultimate VR space for boundless creativity & vibrant social connection! Design your dream planet, decorate, garden, interact with Planet Pals, adopt pets, & share unforgettable moments in this whimsical sandbox life-sim with your friends!

Experience Little Planet FREE-TO-PLAY on Meta Quest (Quest 3, Quest 3s) starting October 30th!
Download Today & Create Your World.

Official Website: https://www.meta.com/experiences/5749790791804399/
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/littleplanet
